title: Nakhal Fort
geometryBasis: The 46-control native compound outline includes three curved bastion extensions, a recessed entrance arm and narrow north-side projection. The northern approach affords a lower terrain datum.
sectionBasis: The dominant central rock rises 13 metres above the original north-side terrain contact. Walls and towers step down to the east and west. The visible rock pockets and rooftop crest heights are inferred from the photograph.
limitations: The original ground grid is preserved. Exposed rock masses integral to the fortress are approximated near the mapped rocky centre.
Wall tops, interior partitions, stair construction and modern restoration details are representative estimates.
Palm groves, visitor amenities, interiors and modern road features are outside the authored scope.
